title: Ringed koszul reflector
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with a sheaf of commutative rings $\mathcal O$, and let $b_1,\ldots,b_r$ be global sections (the finite list may be empty). Put $\mathcal J=(b_1,\ldots,b_r)\mathcal O$. For $N\in D(\mathcal O)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], let $Q_m=\bigotimes_{j=1}^r[\mathcal O\xrightarrow{b_j^m}\mathcal O]$ in degrees $[-r,0]$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves], with transition multiplication by $b_j$ in degree $-1$ and identity in degree $0$ in each factor. Interpret $R\lim$ on the strict tower $N\otimes^L Q_m$ as the total right derived inverse limit, computed by a K-injective resolution of strict towers [def-pur-kinjective-complex, def-weil-derived-limit]. The degree-zero maps $\mathcal O\to Q_m$ induce $\eta_N:N\to R\lim_m(N\otimes^L_{\mathcal O}Q_m)$. The latter object is locally derived $\mathcal J$-complete: for every $U$ and $f\in\mathcal J(U)$, its restriction has zero derived internal Hom from $\mathcal O_U[1/f]$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], where localization means sheafified sectionwise localization. For every object $L$ satisfying this local condition, composition with $\eta_N$ gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}(R\lim_m(N\otimes^L Q_m),L)\to\operatorname{Hom}(N,L)$. Consequently $\eta_N$ is an isomorphism if and only if $N$ satisfies this local condition. The construction and its unit are natural in $N$.

proof.text: For the attached actual-universe pro-etale specialization, apply the published-fiber/Cech comparison to all complexes. For a derived M, use its actual localization preimage C and compose e_C with L(F(QC ≅ M)). Naturality of the Cech unit and the identity e.inv followed by e.hom = id show that F(wfCompletionUnit M) followed by this comparison is exactly eta_(F M). No replacement of the published object or map occurs.

Let L be Cech completion and eta its unit on the comparison site. Both L(eta_E) and eta_(LE) are invertible by the existing two-unit idempotence theorem. Naturality along the object comparison F(T M) ≅ L(F M) transports invertibility of eta_(L(F M)) to eta_(F(T M)); unit normalization and full faithfulness of F then give invertibility of the actual unit of T M. This is precisely WfIsComplete(T M).

For a fixed-unit target N, eta_(F N) is invertible. If unit_M followed by f equals unit_M followed by g, apply LF. The invertibility of L(eta_(F M)) and the comparison cancel L(F unit_M), giving L(F f)=L(F g). Naturality and invertibility of eta_(F N) imply F f=F g; faithfulness implies f=g. For h:M -> N extend by the full-functor preimage of e_M followed by L(F h) followed by inverse eta_(F N). Unit normalization and naturality show its composite with unit_M is h. This proves the required bijection with the specified unit, using real categorical cancellation rather than assuming the reflector conclusion.

theorem wfCompletionReflector :
    (∀ M : PbcCompletedDerived X d,
      WfIsComplete X d r a ha (wfCompletionObj X d r a ha M)) ∧
    ∀ (M L : PbcCompletedDerived X d), WfIsComplete X d r a ha L →
      Function.Bijective (fun f : wfCompletionObj X d r a ha M ⟶ L ↦
        wfCompletionUnit X d r a ha M ≫ f)
lean.note: Section 1(B): the original ringed-site interface fixes the site object and Hom universes equal, so cannot be instantiated on the actual small pro-etale site. Publicly retain that original theorem and supply its completed-coefficient specialization at site sizes u+1/u. The object and unit are exactly the recorded intrinsic Koszul fiber and (u,0) unit, on a genuine representative of the same derived object. The Hom bijection uniquely defines its functor action; no arbitrary completion object or map is chosen.
